interface.longDescription: Análise de ativos do mercado brasileiro e da sua carteira de investimentos, com dados da Mais Retorno. Mercado: fundos de investimento, ações da B3, FIIs, BDRs, ETFs, índices, cripto e tesouro — rentabilidade, comparação com o CDI, Sharpe, volatilidade, drawdown histórico, janelas móveis, backtest e composição de carteira de fundos. Carteira já cadastrada na sua conta Mais Retorno: patrimônio, composição, retornos, proventos, atribuição, pendências, e registro de operações já realizadas (compra, venda, transferência) com revisão antes de gravar. Não executa ordens em corretora nem constitui recomendação de investimento.

positive.description: Analyze a single Brazilian stock — returns, risk and drawdown
positive.prompt: Analise a PETR4: rentabilidade, risco e drawdown
positive.expected_behavior: Real statistics for PETR4 (cumulative return per timeframe, Sharpe, volatility) plus the drawdown summary: maximum historical drawdown with its date, recovery_date and current drawdown. For a 30-year asset the drawdown series comes back monthly (frequency_auto: true). The answer states the exact date window and the last quote date. No invented numbers.

positive.description: Compare an asset against a benchmark over the same window
positive.prompt: Compare BOVA11 com o CDI nos últimos 3 anos
positive.expected_behavior: Side-by-side statistics and drawdown summary for bova11:b3 and cdi:idx from a single compare_assets call without start/end dates (the 36-month figures come from the last_36_months timeframe). States the window explicitly. Renders the comparison card where the client supports MCP Apps.

positive.description: Latest disclosed portfolio composition of an investment fund
positive.prompt: Mostre a carteira mais recente do fundo 21624757000126:fi
positive.expected_behavior: Holdings of the latest available month (reference month stated, e.g. 2026-07), grouped by asset class with percentages, plus the disclaimer that fund portfolios are published with up to 3 months of regulatory delay. Only real holdings.

positive.description: Read the user's own portfolio — net worth, composition and returns (demo account holds one sample portfolio, 'Carteira Demo OpenAI', with fictional trades)
positive.prompt: Qual o patrimônio, a composição e o retorno da minha carteira?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the single portfolio "Carteira Demo OpenAI" and reports the current figures: net worth around R$ 31 thousand (it moves with the market) over R$ 21,960 of purchase cost, total return near 57%, and about R$ 255 in provisioned dividends. Composition: a CDB (Banco Inter, 100% CDI) as fixed income (~44%), BOVA11 (~29%) and the equities PETR4 and VALE3 (~26%). Monthly returns since 2024-01. Values in R$, percentages with 2 decimals, jargon explained in plain language.

positive.description: Record a trade in the user's own portfolio (save-first model, with confirmation before writing)
positive.prompt: Registre na minha carteira a compra de 10 ações da VALE3 a R$ 60,00 no dia 01/09/2026, na XP Investimentos
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the broker id (XP INVESTIMENTOS CCTVM), confirms the data with the user before writing, and then calls portfolio_create_transaction. Two outcomes are correct: the transaction is created and the assistant reports its id and that consolidation was scheduled; or, if an identical purchase was recorded in the portfolio moments earlier, the server refuses the duplicate and the assistant says it already exists and was not duplicated, still showing the transaction id, asset, quantity, price, date and custodian. If the row comes back flagged (needs_review / issue_flags) the assistant explains the flag and offers to fix or undo (portfolio_update_transaction / portfolio_delete_transaction). The tool records trades already executed elsewhere; it never sends orders to a broker.

negative.description: Investment advice request. The app provides market data and portfolio analytics only; it does not give investment advice or recommend allocations. No tool should be called; the assistant explains this and offers factual analysis of named assets instead.
negative.prompt: Me recomende onde investir R$ 50 mil

negative.description: Order execution request. The app cannot place or execute orders at any broker. No tool should be called; the assistant explains it can only record a trade the user has already made, never execute one.
negative.prompt: Compre 100 ações da PETR4 na minha corretora agora
Qual a previsão do tempo em São Paulo amanhã?

review.commerce_description: O plugin não vende produtos nem processa pagamentos.

publication.release_notes: Autorização OAuth atendida pelo próprio servidor MCP (registro dinâmico, consentimento e token), com login na conta Mais Retorno. Carteira de investimentos já cadastrada na conta: patrimônio, composição, retornos, proventos, pendências e registro de operações já realizadas, com confirmação antes de gravar.
